background: Monmouthshire Building Society is a small mutual based in Newport, funded by retail savings from its branches in south-east Wales and the border counties and lending on residential mortgages.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the society, so the filings are the only evidence. Capital is below the peer median on both measures, with CET1 of 14.5% and leverage of 5.6%, and LCR of 170% is in the bottom quarter of UK building societies, while NSFR of 145% sits above the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Apr 2026, so this is a stable but modest position for a small, unrated name.
